title: Types of AI
topic: AI model architecture, training methods and model types
tagline: Where does an AI's skill come from? Three architectures on one tic-tac-toe board, the methods that train them, and the model types the world sorts by.
card_blurb: Compare written rules, a learned value table and a neural network on one tic-tac-toe board, then inspect the network's actual weights. Separate three questions people mix up: how a model is built, how it was trained, and what job it does — the last one linked to Hugging Face's own catalogue of model types.
description: **Types of AI** sorts models two ways. **Model architecture** compares **1a Symbolic AI (GOFAI)**, **1b Value table** and **1c Neural Network** on one tic-tac-toe board, then **1d Other architectures & training methods** widens the map and shows which of the three used supervised, reinforcement or no training at all. **Model types** is the by-task taxonomy from Hugging Face's own task catalogue (fetched 2026-09-16, cited on the page): text generation, text-to-image, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, image-to-3D, text-to-video, image-to-text and the rest, each with what goes in, what comes out, and an outbound link to real models of that type. The symbolic opponent follows eight written rules; the table learns position values through reinforcement; a feedforward network uses supervised learning to approximate frozen estimates from a fresh 20,000-game table learner. The network inspector shows real layers, connection weights, biases and changes from initialization. Exhaustive policy checks support claims about the rules and table. Training/held-out errors measure agreement with the frozen teacher; playing results are measured separately, with no automatic unbeatable claim for the network. During play the network calculates its own scores without consulting the teacher. Ultimate tic-tac-toe remains an optional missing-inputs extension. Built on the shared lesson shell; runs offline with Guide, Settings, in-place Reset, presenter notes and a printable guide.

stages.name: Symbolic AI (GOFAI)
stages.blurb: Eight rules a person wrote. It never learns, and an exhaustive search still finds no losing line.

stages.name: Value table
stages.blurb: One score per position, learned from game outcomes. Train it until the search can call it unbeatable.

stages.name: Neural Network
stages.blurb: Shared weights fitted to the table's frozen scores, with error measured on positions kept out of training.

stages.name: Other architectures & training methods
stages.blurb: The wider map: trees, ensembles, SVMs and the rest, and which of 1a–1c used which training method.

stages.name: Model types
stages.blurb: What a model does rather than how it is built — Hugging Face's own by-task catalogue, with a link to real models of each type.
